blocks.html: Capture your happy moments at Robinsons Galleria’s Love Bear and in Robinsons Magnolia’s Giant Ox display and win special prizes by simply having the highest number of reactions when you upload your photo on your social media accounts. Head to Robinsons Place Manila and have your photos taken at their Rose Bear and Golden Tree to usher the New Year with fun and luck.

Get a chance to win exciting items from partner stores as you shop till you drop at Robinsons Galleria on February 7 to February 14 for a minimum single receipt purchase worth Php3,000 from Robinsons Supermarket or Robinsons Appliances or worth Php2,000 from other participating stores. Treat your family to a delicious feast at Robinsons Magnolia on February 8 to February 14 and get a chance to take home amazing items for just a minimum single receipt purchase worth P1,500 from any restaurant at the mall. Avail of free delivery of gifts delivered to your significant other when you purchase a minimum worth of Php2,000 at any store of Robinsons Place Manila from February 11 to February 14 through our RPersonal Shoppers Robbie and Rosie.

You can also check out at Robinsons Galleria and Robinsons Magnolia’s RPersonal Shopper service, Robbie and Rosie from February 8 to February 14 and receive a special ampao that contains a surprise gift from their partner stores.

Celebrate Chinese New Year with the traditional lion dance and drumbeaters to invite good fortune and prosperity for the year of the Ox at Robinsons Magnolia on February 12 at 11:00 AM. You can also attract good luck in your life when you catch the God of Fortune roaming around Robinsons Place Manila from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM

Of course, the celebration is not complete without the sweet goodness of Chinese glutinous rice cake. Try guessing the weight in grams of the giant tikoy displayed at the Level 2 of Robinsons Galleria or at the Upper Ground Level of Robinsons Magnolia until February 14, guess it right and you can bring home one (1) week supply of the lip-smacking tikoy dessert from Eng Bee Tin.

Love notes and music fill Robinsons Place Manila and Robinsons Magnolia this Valentine’s Day with special performances. Watch out for roving boys and girls as they hand out long-stemmed roses while you dine at Robinsons Magnolia with your loved ones.

And not to miss is the wide array of plant collectibles from Premium Aroids to Rare Arid Plants at Colors of Magnolia Garden Show by Arid and Aroids from February 6 to February 16 at the Atrium of Robinsons Magnolia. Other stores participating are Lots of Cactus, Hardin ni Wowa, Angels Garden, and Masitera Lifestyle Gardening. Plant Mother, Aubrey Miles will be launching her indoor plant brand and a lecture of plant care will be conducted on February 6 at 6:00 PM.

Check out what’s in store for you this year and find out how to bring in good luck with 2021 Chinese Horoscopes and see their long list of special treats and discounts from their partner stores for the whole month of February available on Robinsons Malls Virtual Directory.

Let’s all welcome the Year of the Ox at Robinsons Malls! To see the complete line-up of upcoming performances, events & promos, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or its Virtual Directory bit.ly/RMallsVirtualMallDirectory; or follow RobinsonMalls on Facebook; @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
